title: Automatic legacy project-context migration on planner load
summary: Migrate legacy rules and decisions automatically and atomically during explicit planner load, removing manual Web UI controls.
description: Current state: `packages/plan-core/src/project-context-migration.ts` and `PlanStore.migrateLegacyProjectContext()` already provide deduplicated migration with persisted read-back and rollback, but `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/project-edit.route.tsx` exposes manual Preview migration and Apply previewed migration controls because P090/T353-T354 explicitly avoided migration during load. Replace that user-mediated workflow with a harness-agnostic, idempotent automatic migration invoked by every explicit planner-load lifecycle entry before recap/context delivery. Migrate legacy `globalRules` and `workflowRules` into Project Guidelines and legacy textual `decisions` into structured Accepted Decisions, clear only successfully migrated compatibility fields, and report a concise migration summary. Ordinary entity reads must remain non-mutating. Remove the manual Web UI section while preserving compatible diagnostic/recovery APIs unless a separately approved public-contract change is required. Preserve atomic rollback, deterministic deduplication, agent-only rules, Project Guidelines freshness/read gates, and isolated cross-harness tests.

acceptedDecisions.title: Legacy project context migrates automatically on explicit planner load
acceptedDecisions.decision: Automatically run the existing deduplicated legacy project-context migration before recap/context delivery in every explicit planner-load lifecycle, with no user confirmation buttons; ordinary reads remain non-mutating.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Legacy rules and decisions are schema compatibility data, so requiring the human supervisor to understand and manually trigger their migration creates confusing and unnecessary product friction.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Preserve atomic persisted read-back and rollback, keep successful no-op loads quiet, report concise counts when a migration occurs, remove the Web UI migration card, and retain manual APIs/tools only as backward-compatible recovery diagnostics.

tasks.title: Make legacy project-context migration an idempotent load preparation step
tasks.description: Refactor the existing migration contract in `packages/plan-core/src/project-context-migration.ts` and `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` into a reusable explicit planner-session preparation operation. When legacy `globalRules`, `workflowRules`, or textual `decisions` exist, automatically deduplicate and migrate them into Project Guidelines and structured Accepted Decisions before recap/context is built; when none exist, return a no-op without rewriting files. Preserve persisted read-back verification and exact rollback, keep ordinary `loadProject()` and entity reads non-mutating, and return a concise typed summary for lifecycle adapters. Ensure repeated loads are idempotent, canonical data wins over duplicates, Project Guidelines freshness/session attestations are invalidated only when content changes, and migration timestamps/metadata do not introduce avoidable cross-worktree drift.

checklist.title: Extract a typed planner-load preparation result around the existing migration engine.
Preserve deterministic deduplication, atomic read-back, rollback, and no-op behavior.
Keep ordinary reads non-mutating and invalidate only genuinely stale Guidelines attestations.
Add core tests for first load, repeated load, duplicates, failure rollback, and metadata stability.

tasks.title: Run automatic context migration across every planner-load lifecycle
tasks.description: Wire the plan-core preparation operation into all explicit load entry points in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, and `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts` as applicable: Pi `/planner load`, Pi `planner-load`, MCP `planner-load`, and any supported CLI/session load path. Migration must finish successfully before human recap and agent-only context/skills are delivered. A successful migration returns only a concise user-visible summary of migrated rule/decision counts; no-op loads remain quiet. A verification failure must abort load with a typed diagnostic after restoring the original project. Preserve independent Web UI lifecycle behavior, disabled-by-default planner context, stable harness session identity, Project Guidelines read gates, and backward-compatible manual migration tools as idempotent recovery/diagnostic surfaces.

Keep no-op loads quiet and report only concise successful migration counts.

Run the full build, typecheck, coverage, plugin synchronization, and real-server Playwright suite across desktop/mobile, rebuilding distributed Web UI bundles after success. Document that automatic migration occurs on planner load and ordinary reads remain non-mutating.
